summary: The legacy st and st3 executable names warn on stderr that they will be removed on 2026-11-16; use fractal instead

replay.detail: No claims, projections or caches change.

rules.detail: Command behavior and exit status are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Deprecation: Run `fractal` instead of `st`/`st3`; the aliases are removed on 2026-11-16. Alias invocations add one stderr warning, except shell-completion callbacks and explicitly suppressed internal launches; stdout is unchanged. Set FRACTAL_SUPPRESS_DEPRECATION=1 to preserve legacy stderr temporarily.

manual.detail: Prefer fractal. Scripts parsing legacy stderr can match diagnostic lines or set FRACTAL_SUPPRESS_DEPRECATION=1 until migrated.

recovery.detail: Rollback removes the deprecation warning; no state repair is needed.
